```{=html}
<script>
// Filter the lessons (rendered by _lessons-listing.ejs from each lesson's front matter) by text, instrument, topic and what the page has; the order of the list stays as written. The choices are kept
// (localStorage.llInst, llTopic, llHas) and can be given in the address: lessons/?instrument=bass&topic=blues&has=notation
// has: in each lesson's front matter is written by scripts/lesson-features.cjs from the rendered pages (band, notation, fingering, interactive, svg, images).
(function () {
  var inst = document.getElementById('ll-pick'), topic = document.getElementById('ll-topic'), hasG = document.getElementById('ll-has'), items = document.querySelectorAll('#ll-list li'), note = document.getElementById('ll-note'), qbox = document.getElementById('ll-q');
  function valid(group, attr, v) { return v && group.querySelector('button[' + attr + '="' + v + '"]') ? v : 'all'; }
  function has(li, attr, v) { return v === 'all' || (li.getAttribute(attr) || '').split(' ').indexOf(v) >= 0; }
  var cur = { inst: 'all', topic: 'all', has: 'all', q: '' };
  function words(li) { var w = cur.q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), t = li.textContent.toLowerCase(); return w.every(function (x) { return t.indexOf(x) >= 0; }); }
  function show() {
    var n = 0;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (li) { var on = has(li, 'data-for', cur.inst) && has(li, 'data-topic', cur.topic) && has(li, 'data-has', cur.has) && words(li); li.hidden = !on; if (on) n++; });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(inst.querySelectorAll('button'), function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.getAttribute('data-inst') === cur.inst)); });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(topic.querySelectorAll('button'), function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.getAttribute('data-topic') === cur.topic)); });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(hasG.querySelectorAll('button'), function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.getAttribute('data-has') === cur.has)); });
    note.hidden = n > 0;
    try { localStorage.setItem('llInst', cur.inst); localStorage.setItem('llTopic', cur.topic); localStorage.setItem('llHas', cur.has); } catch (e) {}
  }
  inst.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (b) { cur.inst = b.getAttribute('data-inst'); show(); } });
  topic.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (b) { cur.topic = b.getAttribute('data-topic'); show(); } });
  hasG.addEventListener('click', function (e) { var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (b) { cur.has = b.getAttribute('data-has'); show(); } });
  qbox.addEventListener('input', function () { cur.q = qbox.value; show(); });
  var qi = /[?&]instrument=([a-z]+)/.exec(location.search), qt = /[?&]topic=([a-z]+)/.exec(location.search), qh = /[?&]has=([a-z]+)/.exec(location.search), si = null, st = null, sh = null;
  try { si = localStorage.getItem('llInst'); st = localStorage.getItem('llTopic'); sh = localStorage.getItem('llHas'); } catch (e) {}
  cur.inst = valid(inst, 'data-inst', qi ? qi[1] : si);
  cur.topic = valid(topic, 'data-topic', qt ? qt[1] : st);
  cur.has = valid(hasG, 'data-has', qh ? qh[1] : sh);
  show();
})();
</script>
```
